prompt: I'm cloning gen-zod and want to add a 'preview' variant alongside the existing 'main' variant for the operation Projection. Can you outline which static methods I need to override on the Projection class, and where the 'variant' parameter flows through the entry callbacks? I just want a checklist so I know I've touched everything.

criteria.check: Did the response identify toIdentifier, toExportPath, and toEnrichments as the static methods that take a variant parameter (and need to be variant-aware)?
Did the response identify at least two of the per-call entry callbacks that receive the variant arg: transform, isSupported, toPreviewModule, toMappingModule?
Did the response state that 'main' must remain declared in toEnrichments (the engine throws at start if any consumer writes variants without 'main')?
Did the response use 'static override' (or equivalent language indicating variant Projections override the base via static methods within the same package) rather than introducing a new base class?
